Jane (CS): Weekly health check for MaplePay — quick numbers so we can prep the renewal deck. Usage +8% w/w, tokens ~1.2M, avg batch size 6.7, cache hit rate 18% (up 3pp), cost per 1k tokens $2.10 (down 12%). p95 latency jumped to 420ms from 350ms yesterday. Any obvious causes or risks?
Omar (Eng): Looking at infra logs now. I see a small 5xx spike around 09:12 UTC that coincides with a fallback to the larger model. Digging into logs.
Lucy (SRE): p95 increase aligns with a burst at 09:12 and several unusually long sequences (>1k tokens). Prefetch helps, but KV cache misses on long-tail sessions. Suggest we tweak prefix caching window and batching policy.
Devon (PM): Renewal touch in 9 days. If we can show hit rate improvement + cost savings and a mitigation plan for the latency blip, that's a strong signal. Can we get a 1-slide summary?
Jane (CS): I'll assemble the slide. Can someone confirm the avg batch sample size? I saw 6.7 but large fraction of single-request calls makes that average fragile.
Omar (Eng): Confirmed avg_batch_size=6.7 from a 5k request sample. Dist:
- 60% single-request
- 30% 2-8
- 10% >8
I'll push a quick batching tweak to increase coalesce window from 40ms -> 80ms to capture more coalescing.
Lucy (SRE): Heads up: in our prior tests increasing coalesce window increased tail latency on cold nodes. Recommend conditional window: bump to 80ms only when node CPU < 70%.
Omar (Eng): Proposed deploy snippet (small change):
```
service.maplepay.batching:
  coalesce_window_ms: 80
  max_batch_size: 16
  cpu_threshold_pct: 70
```
billing-bot: Monthly spend alert: MaplePay projected run-rate $18.7k (was $21.2k last month).
Jane (CS): Nice — can we estimate cost per 1k tokens after the change? Target is < $1.95 to show improvement. Also want to confirm error-rate impact.
Omar (Eng): Early sims suggest cost -6% => ~$1.98/1k tokens, but error rate could increase ~0.2% due to timeouts on overloaded nodes. Mitigation: per-node circuit breaker + fallback throttling for long sequences.
Devon (PM): Good. For the renewal slide: bullets: hit rate +3pp, cost per 1k tokens -6%, mitigation plan for latency (conditional coalesce + circuit breaker). Jane will own customer comms.
Jane (CS): I'll draft the slide and send by EOD. @Omar @Lucy please drop 1-2 lines each for the ops note.
Omar (Eng): Will post PR link once the change is deployed.
Lucy (SRE): Added a short runbook note (placeholder): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/maplepay-cache-batching
Jane (CS): Thanks team — check-in complete. :thumbsup:
